status: beta-observation: datamined from the client, not announced by Blizzard; values can still change after launch
how: For each level snapshot (10, 30, 60) the highest rank learnable at or below that level. 'kit' holds the fields as the kit stores them (per-tick values = total / ticks; mana costs given as a share of base mana are converted with Classic base mana). tests/ranks.test.mjs checks the kits against this file.

720 health for 720 + Spirit mana, 10 min cd

10.text: Heals a friendly target for 69 to 83.

Instantly shocks the target with concussive force, causing 36 to 38 Nature damage. It also interrupts spellcasting and prevents any spell in that school from being cast for 2 sec. Causes a high amount of threat.
Casts a bolt of lightning at the target for 26 to 29 Nature damage.

30.text: Casts a bolt of lightning at the target for 79 to 90 Nature damage.

60.text: Casts a bolt of lightning at the target for 191 to 213 Nature damage.
Hurls a lightning bolt at the enemy, dealing 120 to 134 Nature damage and then jumping to additional nearby enemies. Each jump reduces the damage by 30%. Affects 3 total targets.

10.text: Instantly sears the target with fire, causing 24 Fire damage immediately and 28 Fire damage over 12 sec.

30.text: Instantly sears the target with fire, causing 49 Fire damage immediately and 56 Fire damage over 12 sec.

60.text: Instantly sears the target with fire, causing 181 Fire damage immediately and 176 Fire damage over 12 sec.

30.text: Instantly shocks the target with frost, causing 68 to 73 Frost damage and slowing movement speed by 50%. Lasts 8 sec.

60.text: Instantly shocks the target with frost, causing 284 to 300 Frost damage and slowing movement speed by 50%. Lasts 8 sec.

30.text: You hurl molten lava at the target, dealing 114 to 145 Fire damage. If your Flame Shock is on the target, Lava Burst deals 20% increased damage.

60.text: You hurl molten lava at the target, dealing 203 to 258 Fire damage. If your Flame Shock is on the target, Lava Burst deals 54% increased damage.

10.text: Summons a Strength of Earth Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster. The totem increases the strength of party or raid members within 30 yards by 7. Lasts 5 min.

30.text: Summons a Strength of Earth Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster. The totem increases the strength of party or raid members within 30 yards by 14. Lasts 5 min.

60.text: Summons a Strength of Earth Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster. The totem increases the strength of party or raid members within 30 yards by 53. Lasts 5 min.

10.text: Summons a Searing Totem with 5 health at your feet for 30 sec that repeatedly attacks an enemy within 20 yards for 9 to 11 Fire damage.

30.text: Summons a Searing Totem with 5 health at your feet for 40 sec that repeatedly attacks an enemy within 20 yards for 19 to 25 Fire damage.

60.text: Summons a Searing Totem with 5 health at your feet for 55 sec that repeatedly attacks an enemy within 20 yards for 40 to 54 Fire damage.

30.text: Summons a Mana Spring Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster for 5 min that restores 4 mana every 2 seconds to group members within 30 yards.

60.text: Summons a Mana Spring Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster for 5 min that restores 10 mana every 2 seconds to group members within 30 yards.

30.text: Summons a Healing Stream Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster for 5 min that heals group members within 30 yards for 6 every 2 seconds.

60.text: Summons a Healing Stream Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster for 5 min that heals group members within 30 yards for 11 every 2 seconds.
Summons a Grace of Air Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster. The totem increases the agility of party or raid members within 30 yards by 89. Lasts 5 min.

30.text: Instantly inflicts 54 to 62 fire damage to enemies within 10 yd of your active Fire totem.

60.text: Instantly inflicts 232 to 259 fire damage to enemies within 10 yd of your active Fire totem.
